name: A Murder In The Public Domain
source: A Murder In The Public Domain is a murder mystery game or visual novel built from public domain movies, sounds, pictures, and images. I cobble these all together into a mystery story.  The game follows the adventures of Dirk Caliber and Mary Livingston as they try to solve the murder of her mysterious employer.  The game will always end at a conclusive point but I intend to extend it.  How many times? No idea.  In what direction will the story go?  No idea.  As I find new movies, clip art, images, sounds, and music, I let them guide the story.  Since I'm doing the programming I also expect I'll extend the user interface over time.  How?  No idea, usually it just comes to me.  Hope you enjoy it.
translation:
《公共领域谋杀案》是一款由公版电影、声音、照片与图像制作而成的推理游戏，也可以说是一部视觉小说。我把这些素材拼接成一个谋杀故事。

游戏讲述德克·口径与玛丽·利文斯顿的冒险：两人试图查明玛丽神秘雇主被杀的真相。故事每次都会在一个完整的节点结束，但我打算继续扩展。要扩展多少次？不知道。故事会朝哪个方向发展？不知道。

每当我找到新的电影片段、剪贴画、图片、声音或音乐，就会让它们引导故事前进。因为程序也是我自己编写的，所以用户界面也会随着时间不断扩展。怎么扩展？不知道，通常灵感会自己出现。希望你能享受这段体验。
